annotation.kind: faithful reconstruction of Theorem 3.1 with an explicit Frobenius-condition-number interpretation, polynomial witness for c(n,k), and second-order remainder semantics for lesssim

assumptions: The dimension n is positive, A and the left preconditioner ML have certified inverses, b is nonzero, and xExact solves A*xExact=b.
The search spaces form an increasing full-column-rank basis family and the MGS analysis records a positive key dimension k<=n.
The four Algorithm 2 modules satisfy equations (3.2)-(3.4), the MGS/Givens least-squares perturbation model, numerical nonsingularity, and conditions (3.5)-(3.6).

For each certified nonsingular analytical right preconditioner MR, the Appendix-A certificate supplies exact singular-value data and four separately typed propagated contributions whose sum equals the computed forward error up to a second-order remainder.
All matrix and vector quantities are real, so exceptional floating-point values and range failures are outside the model.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p19_t2_modular_gmres_forward_error {n : Nat} {iota : Type*} {l : Filter iota} [l.NeBot] (execution : P19Theorem31Execution (n := n) l) : exists k : Nat, k = execution.run.keyDimension and 0 < k and k <= n and (forall eventually t in l, 1 / (execution.run.vHatSpectrum t).sigmaMin <= 4 / 3 and (execution.run.vHatSpectrum t).sigmaMax <= 4 / 3) and forall MR MRinv, p19InversePair MR MRinv -> p19FirstOrderLeAt l (p19PrecisionScale execution.run) (fun t => p19ForwardError execution.run.xExact (execution.run.xHat t)) (fun t => p19PolynomialFactorValue execution.run.polynomialFactor n k * p19Xi execution.run MR MRinv (execution.forwardAnalysis MR MRinv _).quantities t * p19ConditionNumberF (p19SplitOperator execution.run MRinv) (p19SplitInverse execution.run MR))
formal_statement.plain_language: At an MGS-selected dimension k no larger than n, the computed Krylov basis satisfies both 4/3 conditioning bounds and, for every nonsingular analytical right preconditioner, Algorithm 2's computed solution satisfies Theorem 3.1's normalized first-order forward-error bound with the exact alpha, beta, lambda, and xi formulas.

informal_proof: Use the MGS orthogonality-defect estimates and the certified extremal singular values to obtain the two 4/3 bounds at the recorded key dimension. For an arbitrary certified right preconditioner, apply the Euclidean triangle inequality to the exact Appendix-A decomposition, divide by the nonzero exact-solution norm, apply the four source-specific propagation bounds, collect their coefficients into xi, and retain the normalized remainder as O((epsilonC+epsilonB+ug+epsilonX)^2).
informal_statement: The complete modular attainable-forward-error result of Theorem 3.1, with explicit norm and first-order semantics.
